articles.title: Hackers Abuse Linux Cron Jobs to Maintain Persistent Malware Access on Firewalls and Switches
articles.summary:

The campaign highlights a blind spot for operators of Linux-based firewalls and switches: reviewing the vendor configuration does not show whether the underlying operating system is running unauthorized jobs. articles.title: Hackers Turn AI Coding Agent Configuration Files Into Malware Execution and Propagation Channels
articles.summary:
